clauses.reason: The printed order itself enacts approval and adoption at issuance. That establishes the occurrence of those dispositions, but does not establish that the legal authorization thereby conferred or the approved substantive provisions ceased then. The approved material is not reproduced in the inspected printing or held in this dossier. No independent reporting, enforcement, transfer or other administrative command appears on the face of the approval page; commands, duration, savings and residual rights within the approved material remain unexamined. No held actor, own-term ending or current predicate closes these questions. Provisional NO supplies no ending. Number-only machine searches do not supply the missing industry-specific history; OFR begins in 1937 and cannot close the pre-1937 gap, and the USC release omits enactments October 10-14, 2026. No later cleanup, general statutory change or silence is used as an end. The coming season is a recital explaining urgency, not an operative sunset. It does not establish performance, a season end date, or cessation of the approved labor provisions.
